cruise-controller-model.name: No Throttle When Overspeeding
cruise-controller-model.subject: s
cruise-controller-model.expression_text:
currentTime > 0 implies
                    (s.lastObservedSpeed > s.controller.targetSpeedMps + s.controller.toleranceMps
                        implies not s.controller.throttleOn)

cruise-controller-model.name: Accelerate When Below Target
cruise-controller-model.subject: s
cruise-controller-model.expression_text:
currentTime > 0 implies
                    (s.lastObservedSpeed < s.controller.targetSpeedMps - s.controller.toleranceMps
                        and s.lastObservedGap >= s.controller.safeFollowingDistanceMeters
                        implies s.controller.throttleOn)

cruise-controller-model.name: Brake When Above Target Or Too Close
cruise-controller-model.subject: s
cruise-controller-model.expression_text:
currentTime > 0 implies
                    (s.lastObservedSpeed > s.controller.targetSpeedMps + s.controller.toleranceMps
                        or s.lastObservedGap < s.controller.safeFollowingDistanceMeters
                        implies s.controller.brakeOn)

mixing-sysml-model.name: No Dry Running
mixing-sysml-model.subject: s
mixing-sysml-model.expression_text:
(s.controller.observedLevel1 <= 0 implies not s.pump1.isRunning) and
                (s.controller.observedLevel2 <= 0 implies not s.pump2.isRunning)

mixing-sysml-model.name: No Dead Heading
mixing-sysml-model.subject: s
mixing-sysml-model.expression_text:
(not s.valve1.isOpen implies not s.pump1.isRunning) and
                (not s.valve2.isOpen implies not s.pump2.isRunning)

mixing-sysml-model.name: Fluid Transfer Termination Safety
mixing-sysml-model.subject: s
mixing-sysml-model.expression_text:
(s.controller.lastScanTimeSeconds > 0) implies
                ((s.controller.tank1OriginalLevelMl - s.controller.observedLevel1 >= s.controller.tank1TransferMl + s.controller.toleranceMl)
                  implies not s.pump1.isRunning) and
                ((s.controller.tank2OriginalLevelMl - s.controller.observedLevel2 >= s.controller.tank2TransferMl + s.controller.toleranceMl)
                  implies not s.pump2.isRunning)

mixing-sysml-model.name: Fluid Transfer Liveness
mixing-sysml-model.subject: s
mixing-sysml-model.expression_text:
(s.controller.lastScanTimeSeconds > 0) implies
                ((s.controller.tank1OriginalLevelMl - s.controller.observedLevel1 < s.controller.tank1TransferMl)
                    implies (s.valve1.isOpen and s.pump1.isRunning) and
                  (s.controller.tank2OriginalLevelMl - s.controller.observedLevel2 < s.controller.tank2TransferMl)
                    implies (s.valve2.isOpen and s.pump2.isRunning))

thermostat.name: Heat When Cold
thermostat.subject: s
thermostat.expression_text:
currentTime > 0 implies 
                    (s.lastObservedTemperature < s.controller.setPointCelcius - s.controller.toleranceCelcius
                        implies s.controller.heaterOn)

thermostat.name: Cool When Hot
thermostat.subject: s
thermostat.expression_text:
currentTime > 0 implies
                    (s.lastObservedTemperature > s.controller.setPointCelcius + s.controller.toleranceCelcius
                        implies s.controller.acOn)
